question: Should ai& be accepted as a permanent built-in CodexBar provider based on its coding-agent focus, documented request-log API, and funded-account proof?
rationale: The implementation appears bounded and technically sound, but adding a provider ID, settings surface, documentation, and long-term API maintenance obligation requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor built-in provider
options.body: Accept ai& as a default-disabled built-in provider after the changelog entry is removed and current-head checks pass.

options.title: Decline permanent scope
options.body: Close the PR if CodexBar does not want to own ongoing support for this provider.

recommendation.title: Sponsor built-in provider
recommendation.body: Accept ai& as a default-disabled built-in provider after the changelog entry is removed and current-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority for permanent built-in provider scope.
